info.title: Project Worlds
info.description: Hand-maintained contract fixture for the Station vNext UI (regenerate types with `npm run api:generate`). Endpoint shapes consumed by the UI are verified against src/personal_world (api.py, auth_routes.py, prefs.py, sections.py, status.py, classification.py, template_registry.py, api_manifest.py, envelope.py) on 2026-09-20 — the deployed Station serves /openapi.json as HTTP 500, so the spec cannot be fetched from the live server. Unconsumed endpoints still reflect the older wave-0 snapshot and may drift from the server.

parameters.name: ts
parameters.description: Timestamp of the entry whose chain to show

JournalEvent.description: model.JournalEvent (pydantic dump; every key always present).

ChatRequest.description: POST /api/chat body. The server picks the reasoning provider; there is no per-request provider field.

context.description: Where in the UI the person is (provenance, not truth).

ChatResponse.description: POST /api/chat → Result dump; data keys are provider-dependent ({reply, provider, usage, proposal?}).

Actor.description: model.Actor — staff-directory entry for a connected PROVIDER (not a companion).

SessionResponse.description: GET /api/auth/session (auth_routes.py): ok:false + status when not signed in.

ConfigField.description: A single configuration field for a provider.

CapabilitySchema.description: Full schema for a capability: available providers, active config.

ConnectionOverviewEntry.description: Per-capability overview for the Connections & Providers UI.

ConnectionSaveRequest.description: Save or update a connection (step-up required).

ConnectionTestRequest.description: Test or validate a connection configuration without saving.

IdentityUser.description: A user record from the identity store.

UserCreateRequest.description: Create a new person (admin only, step-up required).

AgentRecord.description: An agent record from the identity store.

DiscoveryInterest.description: A tracked interest for content discovery.

VaultActionResponse.description: POST /api/vault/unlock — all four keys always present; data may be null.

CapabilityStatus.description: Server Status enum (src/personal_world/status.py) — the shared status vocabulary.

JournalNoteRequest.description: POST /api/journal body {text}. Stored as an observation.

supersedes.description: ts of the entry being replaced

ChatHistoryEntry.description: ChatHistory NDJSON line — ts is unix epoch SECONDS (float).

PrefsData.description: prefs.normalize_prefs() — every key always present (defaults fill in).

PrefsUpdateRequest.description: PUT /api/prefs — partial update; unknown keys or below-floor values fail 400 as a whole.

SectionsUpdateRequest.description: PUT /api/sections body — sections.validate_layout_update(): {order?, hidden?} id lists.
